entries.title: 1 Chronicles 10:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Saul's overthrow and death. 8 The Philistines triumph over Saul. 11 The kindness of Jabesh-gilead towards Saul and his sons. 13 Saul's sin, for which the kingdom was translated from him to David.

A.M. 2948. B.C. 1056. the Philistines fought. 1Sa 28:1; 29:1,2; 31:1,2-13 slain. or, wounded. mount. 8; 1Sa 28:4; 31:1; 2Sa 1:6,21; 21:12

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 10:2
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Jonathan. 8:33; 9:39; 1Sa 14:6,39,40; 2Ki 23:29; Isa 57:1,2 Abinadab. 1Sa 14:49 Ishui. the sons. Ex 20:5; 2Ki 25:7

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 10:3
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: went. 1Sa 31:3-6; 2Sa 1:4-10; Am 2:14 archers. Heb. shooters with bows. hit. Heb. found. hewas. Ge 49:23,24

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 10:6
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: Saul. 1Sa 4:10,11,18; 12:25; Ec 9:1,2; Ho 13:10,11 all his house."All his men," in Samuel; that is, all who were present with him in the battle; and his family received such a blow, that it never recovered itself again. For though Ishbosheth reigned over a part of the country, yet it was not in any splendour. This history seems to be repeated here as an introduction to that of the kingdom of David.

entries.title: 1 Chronicles 10:13
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content: committed. Heb. transgressed. even against. 1Sa 13:13; 15:2,23 for asking. 1Sa 28:7-20 a familiar. Ex 22:18; Le 19:31; 20:6; De 18:10-14; 2Ki 21:6; Isa 8:19 Ac 8:9-11; 16:16-18
